options.title: What if Antarctica's ice all melted?
options.first_line: What if every bit of ice on Antarctica melted? Watch where the sea goes.
options.first_frame: The whole world map seen from space, Antarctica glowing white at the bottom, its ice already starting to drip into the blue.

options.title: Antarctica melts. Which countries vanish first?
options.first_line: Antarctica's ice melts, all of it. Which countries vanish from the map first?
options.first_frame: Antarctica's white ice cap cracking on the world map while the coastlines of Europe and Asia start to flicker blue.

options.title: Melt Antarctica: what's left of the map?
options.first_line: Melt every bit of ice on Antarctica, and redraw the world map. What's left?
options.first_frame: A hand with an eraser rubbing out Antarctica's white ice on the world map, blue water spreading from it.

why: B names Antarctica and asks a concrete question a stranger wants answered (which countries vanish first, maybe mine), without A's "Watch where the sea goes" tease or C's vaguer "what's left", and its first frame of coastlines flickering says the most with the sound off.
